description.value: Marina Grill & Pub is the casual dining and drinking hub of Westview Marina & Lodge, a long-established fishing and recreational boating destination on the remote west coast of Vancouver Island near Tahsis, BC. The pub menu focuses on crowd-pleasing favorites, supplemented by a small ice cream stand, and a large outdoor covered heated patio hosts 'Rock the Docks' live music on summer Friday nights. The business caters primarily to fishing charter clients and boaters, giving it a lively, community-oriented atmosphere in an otherwise very isolated setting.
